fields.description: Choose whether to save results as drafts or submit them immediately
fields.label: After Calculation
fields.options:
Save as Draft
Save and Submit

fields.description: Recommended for large batches. Progress and a full log are shown either way.
fields.label: Run in Background

fields.description: Leave blank to calculate for all student groups
fields.label: Student Group (Optional)

fields.description: How to treat subject results (or term reports, for year calculation) that are still in Draft. "Ignore" uses submitted records only and warns about drafts. "Include" counts drafts as if submitted. "Block" refuses to run while drafts exist.
fields.label: Draft Data Handling
fields.options:
Ignore Draft Results
Include Draft Results
Block if Drafts Exist

fields.description: What to do when a student is missing results for subjects that other students in the same group have
fields.label: Missing Subject Handling
fields.options:
Calculate with Available Subjects
Skip Students with Missing Subjects
Block if Any Subject Missing

fields.description: Skip students marked as inactive in the Student Group (e.g. left the school). Their results are reported in the preview but no report card is generated.
fields.label: Only Active Students

fields.description: What to do when a report for a student already exists and is submitted. "Replace" cancels, deletes and recreates it with fresh numbers. "Skip" leaves it untouched.
fields.label: Existing Submitted Reports
fields.options:
Replace Existing Submitted Reports
Skip Existing Submitted Reports

fields.description: Courses with "Exclude from Result Average" checked on the Course master (e.g. Art in KG) are shown on reports but not counted in averages. Uncheck to ignore those flags for this run.
fields.label: Respect Course-Level Exclusion Flags

fields.description: Additional courses to exclude from average calculation for this run only. Their scores still appear on the reports.
fields.label: Also Exclude These Courses

fields.description: How to handle students who don't have results for every term (joined mid-year, left, expelled, ...). "Average Available Terms" uses only the terms the student attended and marks the report as Partial Year. "Treat Missing Terms as Zero" counts each missing term as 0. "Exclude" skips those students entirely. "Block" refuses to run while any student has missing terms.
fields.label: Missing Term Handling
fields.options:
Average Available Terms
Treat Missing Terms as Zero
Exclude Students with Missing Terms
Block if Any Term Missing

fields.description: "Average of Term Averages" weighs each term equally. "Average of Course Year Percentages" averages each course's combined year percentage (weighs terms by their maximum scores).
fields.label: Year Average Method
fields.options:
Average of Term Averages
Average of Course Year Percentages

fields.description: Which terms make up the year. Leave empty to auto-detect every term of the academic year that has submitted term reports.
fields.label: Terms to Include
